# prebuilds

Manage Optimus-IDE-Collab prebuilds

Aliases:

* prebuild

## Usage

```console
optimus-ide-collab prebuilds
```

## Description

```console
Administrators can use these commands to manage prebuilt workspace settings.
  - Pause Optimus-IDE-Collab prebuilt workspace reconciliation.:

     $ optimus-ide-collab prebuilds pause

  - Resume Optimus-IDE-Collab prebuilt workspace reconciliation if it has been paused.:

     $ optimus-ide-collab prebuilds resume
```

## Subcommands

| Name                                         | Purpose          |
|----------------------------------------------|------------------|
| [<code>pause</code>](./prebuilds_pause.md)   | Pause prebuilds  |
| [<code>resume</code>](./prebuilds_resume.md) | Resume prebuilds |
